A fruit that shares a name with a color is orange.

The text explores the implicit theme of the paradoxical nature of isolation. While the lighthouse keeper is physically separated from society, his role as a guide creates a profound, albeit distant, connection with the world. The lighthouse itself serves as a symbol of steadfastness and hope in the face of uncertainty, suggesting that purpose can be found even in solitude. The darkness surrounding the light represents the unknown or the struggles of others, while the keeper’s vigilance highlights the human need to find meaning by serving a greater good, even when that service is silent and unseen.
